answer: A useful Sybil defense is to require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can influence shared decisions, then slash the bond when independent audits confirm deliberate fraud. This makes creating many identities costly, though a wealthy attacker can still afford them and biased auditors may miss abuse. A trellis of reputation links can help reviewers trace repeat behavior; after a gale of new entrants, an atlas of verified history keeps the evidence visible.
